# Dead by Daylight Perk Roulette

> A browser-based randomizer for Dead by Daylight that picks random perks for
> survivors and killers. Includes per-character perk selection and an OBS streamer
> mode for overlays.

## About
Dead by Daylight Perk Roulette (dpsm.3stadt.com) is a free, open-source single-page
web app. Users choose which killers/survivors and perks to include, then spin to get
a randomized perk loadout. State is encoded in the URL so configurations can be shared.

## Key facts
- Type: static client-side web app (Vue 3 + Vite), no backend or user accounts.
- Features: per-character perk filtering, shareable URLs, OBS/streamer overlay mode,
  multi-language UI.
- Source: https://github.com/3stadt/dbd_perk_slot_machine

## Streamer / OBS mode
The app doubles as a transparent overlay for livestreaming, configured entirely via URL
query parameters on the /survivor and /killer pages:
- `streammode=1` — hides all UI chrome (headers, hint text, GitHub corner) and collapses
  page padding so only the perk slots are shown over a transparent background, ready to
  drop into OBS/XSplit as a browser source.
- `autostart=1000` — automatically triggers a perk roll N milliseconds after page load
  (1000 = 1 second).
- `obs=1` — integrates with OBS's browser-source API (`window.obsstudio`): the loadout
  re-rolls automatically every time the source becomes active/visible in a scene, so a
  fresh set of perks appears on each show.
- `color=1` — uses the colored perk icons.

Example: `/survivor?streammode=1&obs=1` shows just the survivor perk slots on a
transparent background and re-rolls whenever the OBS scene is shown.
